text:
Alina: morning — quick heads up, I'm on a client call that might run into my 09:00–10:00 oncall window. can someone cover primary for ~45m? :wave:
Mike: I can pick up primary for the window, no problem. are you able to handoff now?
Alina: yes, passing now. key things: low-latency tier is in canary, watch for 5xxs from /v1/generate. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/latency-spike — section 'canary fallback'
Tariq: noted. Mike — make sure the canary fallback policy is enabled in the console (route weight -> 0.25). if you need the exact CLI: `redwoodctl routes update --name canary --weight 0.25`
Mike: got it, running that now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout to canary-gpu-pool at 1769123458 — started by @Alina. status: 1/3 pods healthy.
Sasha: pinging telemetry — I see a slight bump in p50 for embed requests in eu-west-1, not yet 5xx. might be correlated with the canary traffic.
Mike: route update successful. `redwoodctl routes update` returned exit 0. re-checking dashboards.
Tariq: for anyone stepping in: quick checklist I copy here — useful during short swaps:
```
- Confirm primary badge in oncall UI -> show as "primary: <name>"
- Verify pager sub-route has active fallback configured
- Check token-level cost drop if batching increases
- If 5xx > 1% over 1m, enable canary rollback: `redwoodctl rollouts rollback --id <canary-id>`
- Notify support if customer-facing SLA might be breached
```
Alina: also FYI — I'm on a 15m call then might be reachable to handback. thanks Mike :heart:
pagerbot: Pager created: PGR-1132 — Priority: P2. Trigger: 5xx spike on /v1/generate, last triggered 1769123490. Assigned: oncall-primary.
Mike: saw the pager, investigating logs. `kubectl logs -l app=generate -n prod --since=5m | grep ERROR | tail -n 20` shows a spiky noise from an internal redis timeout. pushing a temporary retry backoff change to reduce failures.
Tariq: if it's redis, check the dedicated pool metrics and kv-cache hit rate. if hit rate drops, we might be seeing eviction storms after the canary.
Sasha: kv cache hit rate is 92% -> no gross evictions. redis p99 latency did spike to 120ms at 1769123488 then recovered.
Mike: rolled back the retry patch (was a small client-side aggressive backoff). error rate dropping. monitoring.
Alina: can I jump back in at :10 to take primary again?
Mike: yes, I'll hand it back at 1769123600. leaving notes in the incident channel and runbook link.
Alina: thanks all. leaving a short follow-up ticket for infra to look at that redis p99 blip: INC-2409.
ops-bot: runbook-note: handoff recorded 1769123599 — primary: Mike -> Alina.
Mike: handed back to Alina. primary badge updated. everything trending to normal. :thumbsup:
Alina: back on primary. will triage INC-2409 tomorrow morning with infra. thanks for coverage!
